asr_text: Eleven Lab's voice -changer gave George an American accent, here's why. In voice -changer, your input sample determines the output characteristics. Pick British George, record with an American accent, you get George American. Upload a Portuguese -accented sample, and that language and accent are kept. Same with emotion, a flat read gives a flat result, perform it. Check your mic gain and turn on remove background noise. Save this and watch the full lesson in episode 8.
